name: CursorBench
intro: CursorBench 是 Cursor 基于内部工程团队真实会话持续更新的私有编程智能体评测套件；截至 2026-07-18，线上版本为 3.2，覆盖模糊、多文件、指令遵循和高级工具使用任务。
build_method: 用 Cursor Blame 将已提交代码追溯到生成它的智能体请求，形成开发者请求与标准解法对，并从内部/受控来源筛选、每隔数月刷新
metric: CursorBench 3.2 排行榜报告得分、单任务平均成本、Token 数和步骤数；成本按公开输入/缓存读/缓存写/输出单价乘实际用量，并使用与得分相同的任务权重，具体得分公式和权重未公开
eval_feature: 按技术报告初始化代码库与初始提示，并在等同生产环境中运行智能体；智能体裁判评估欠指定任务，离线结果另与受控线上代理指标及消融交叉核对
build_method_en: Use Cursor Blame to trace committed code to the agent request that produced it, pair the developer query with its ground-truth solution, curate internal/controlled sources, and refresh every few months
eval_feature_en: Per the technical report, the codebase and initial prompt are initialized and the agent runs as in production; agentic graders score underspecified tasks, and offline results are separately cross-checked with controlled online proxies and ablations
intro_en: CursorBench is Cursor's continuously updated private coding-agent suite built from real internal engineering sessions. As retrieved on 2026-07-18, the live version is 3.2 and includes ambiguous multi-file, instruction-following, and advanced-tool-use tasks.
metric_en: CursorBench 3.2 reports score, average cost per task, tokens, and steps; cost applies published input/cache-read/cache-write/output prices and averages with the same task weights as score, while the score formula and weights are undisclosed

drawio_review_note: There is no CursorBench-only standalone paper, but Cursor Research formally introduces the benchmark in Composer 2 Technical Report arXiv:2603.24477v2 (§5, §7.1, Appendix C; PDF SHA-256 933e9f2720966b6d744b8295af0fe2c2fb4c3d9efc3d23a4d27b4b0b08c0d068). CursorBench has no public repository and no public dataset. The package also pins Cursor's official methodology post dated March 11, 2026 and the live leaderboard/changelog retrieved 2026-07-18. Cursor Blame traces committed code to the agent request that produced it, creating a developer-query/committed-solution pair; tasks come mainly from internal and controlled sources and refresh every few months. Version 3.0 introduced edit, refactor, and bug-fix tasks; 3.1 added codebase understanding, bug finding, planning, and code review and revised some edit-task grading; CursorBench 3.2 was released July 8, 2026 with instruction-following and advanced-tool-use problems. The July 9 reporting update corrected cache-write cost accounting. The report initializes the codebase environment and initial prompt and runs the agent as it executes in production; agentic graders score underspecified tasks. Its CursorBench-3 snapshot reports median 181 lines changed and a 390-character prompt, which are not current 3.2 size or task-count claims. Internal axes include correctness, code quality, efficiency, and interaction behavior; the public 3.2 page reports Score, average cost per task, tokens, and steps. Cost applies published input/cache-read/cache-write/output prices to task usage and averages with the same task weights as score, but task weights and the score formula are not disclosed. Controlled online outcome proxies and ablations are a separate cross-check, not a documented feedback edge into suite construction. Scores should be compared only within one eval version and small differences may reflect variance. The live page warns that Grok 4.5 saw an older Cursor codebase snapshot, that the exact impact is unclear, and that the data was removed for future models. Task count, item list, split, grader prompts/rubrics, harness, score weights, and per-item outputs remain proprietary.
